facts.text: I am looking for ideas to organize the clutter on my coffee table.
I like the idea of using a tray or container to corral small items.
I want trays or containers that would work with a vintage-style living room.
I am looking for trays or containers that will go well with my vintage-style lamp.
I want recommendations for trays or containers with an art deco design.
I am thinking of getting a metal tray with a geometric pattern.
I am considering whether a brass or copper finish would look better with my vintage-style lamp.
I will go with the brass finish.
I like the warm, luxurious look that the brass finish adds to the space.
I want a high-quality brass metal tray with a geometric pattern.
I am thinking of getting a tray that is around 12-15 inches in diameter.
I want to know whether a 12-15 inch diameter tray is a good size for a coffee table.
